description: Corrects substitution errors with the Musket k-mer spectrum corrector (Liu, Schmidt & Maskell 2013). k-mers with multiplicity >= minKmerFrequency are trusted. Default: Musket stage 1 (two-sided conservative correction: per iteration, the first untrusted position with exactly one alternative base making both its leftmost and rightmost covering k-mers trusted is substituted; ambiguous positions unchanged), iterated to convergence over a canonical (both-strand) k-mer spectrum as Musket counts it. musket=true runs the full Musket 1.1 corrector (canonical both-strand k-mers, -maxiter 2, -maxerr 4: adds the aggressive one-sided stage and the voting stage); countReverseComplement=false (forward-strand-only spectrum) / maxIterations / maxErrorsPerKmer override the chosen preset. Non-ACGT symbols (N, IUPAC codes, U) are read as A by the k-mer spectrum (Musket 2-bit encoding); a base no correction replaces keeps its upper-cased input symbol.

kmerSize.description: K-mer size used to build the frequency table (>= 1). Default 21 (Musket -k default).

minKmerFrequency.description: Trusted cut-off (>= 1): k-mers with multiplicity >= this value are trusted (Musket -minmulti). Default 3 = the smallest value Musket's own valley estimator can return.

musket.description: Run the full Musket 1.1 corrector (both strands, -maxiter 2, -maxerr 4) instead of the two-sided stage only (default).

countReverseComplement.description: Optional: count each k-mer together with its reverse complement (canonical k-mers, as Musket); overrides the preset.

maxIterations.description: Optional: Musket -maxiter, correcting iterations per stage (>= 1); overrides the preset.

maxErrorsPerKmer.description: Optional: Musket -maxerr, maximum corrections per k-mer window in the aggressive stage (0 = two-sided stage only); overrides the preset.

corrected.description: Corrected reads, upper-cased, in input order (length and count preserved).

errors.message: k-mer size must be at least 1
minKmerFrequency must be at least 1, maxIterations at least 1, maxErrorsPerKmer not negative
